lines.zh: 我的脚掌压在冰上，响一声。
lines.en: My paw presses the ice and it cracks once.

lines.zh: 这身白毛在雪里几乎看不见。
lines.en: This white coat nearly disappears in snow.
Each of my strides is longer than a man's.
The ice is slick; I walk steadily.
The northern wind pushes me along.

lines.zh: 鼻子在雪里拱出一条沟。
lines.en: My snout ploughs a furrow in the snow.
It is too cold here even for birds.
By the icy water, I walk slowly.
My belly is still empty.
I know the sound of cracking ice.

lines.zh: 我的影子在雪上是灰的。
lines.en: My shadow looks grey on the snow.
I walk slowly, saving my strength.
There is a floe ahead.
I lift a paw and test its thickness.
There are no tracks in this snow.
I left a trail of them.
I stand with the wind at my back.
Snow settles on my shoulders and does not melt.
I lift my head and sniff the air.
Something moves under the ice.
I sit and breathe out white.
I am used to this cold.
My claws are wider than a palm.
Floes knock together far off.
I wait for night.
Nothing hides in snow for long.
I lower my head against my forelegs.
When the wind rises, I stop moving.
The water under the ice sounds muffled.

lines.zh: 我爪子上有一道旧裂口。
lines.en: There is an old split in my paw.

lines.zh: 雪一盖上来，就看不见了。
lines.en: Once the snow covers it, it vanishes.
I stand and shake out my coat.
This ice is mine.
The wind here bites.

lines.zh: 你在地图上大概是个点。
lines.en: On a map you would be a dot.

lines.zh: 我的爪子比你的脸还大。
lines.en: My paw is bigger than your face.
You are at the edge of my shadow.

lines.zh: 我的鼻息在冷空气里成雾。
lines.en: My breath fogs the cold air.

lines.zh: 我不常在这里见到你这种人。
lines.en: I rarely see your kind here.
Your hands are red with cold.
You move slowly.
I can wait.

lines.zh: 你手指僵得握不住东西。
lines.en: Your fingers are too stiff to grip.

lines.zh: 再站一会儿你就得动了。
lines.en: Stand a moment longer and you will have to move.
I roar, muffled.
Red stains my coat.
I took that one.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，冰响了一声。
lines.en: Half a step back, and the ice cracks.
The hide is thick, and pain still comes.
That was an accurate blow.
I turn and look at you.
My scent is still in the snow.
This wound is nothing much.
I can still walk a long way.

lines.zh: 海豹的油味，从你身上来。
lines.en: Seal oil; the smell comes from you.
It smells a little fishy.
Your hand must be stiff by now.
Let me see it.
I am not picky, as long as it is food.
Set it on the snow, not the ice.
I eat slowly.
You are of some use after all.
Is there anything else?
Too cold to speak?
One piece is not enough.
I eat several meals a day.
The smell is still on your hands.
A little more.

lines.zh: 我把雪刨开，把食物放下。
lines.en: I scrape the snow and set the food down.
Stand farther off.

lines.zh: 我这身白毛底下，全是硬肉。
lines.en: Under this white coat is solid muscle.
I barely noticed.
The snow sinks under me.
You have moved to my flank.
That side is solid too.
I did not mean to block the way.
This shoreline is narrow.
You go on ahead, then.
The ice creaks under my paws.
That is wide enough.
This season I walk alone.
That waits until spring.
The ice is no place for such talk.

lines.zh: 我连自己的伴都没找到。
lines.en: I have not even found a mate.
Your question is far too abrupt.
The snow will bury this subject.
Let us change the subject.
I only want to guard this floe.
The wind is too loud.
I walk away.
There is something on the ground.
It is half buried in snow.
I root it out with my snout.
It has frozen solid.
This thing on the ice smells of seal.
I bit it and could not break it.
You take it.

lines.zh: 这东西在我爪子里太小。
lines.en: It is tiny in my paw.
I push it toward you.
The snow will cover it again.

lines.zh: 你身上有别的东西的味道。
lines.en: You carry the smell of something else.
Blood.
Not yours.
I have stood up.
You will not run fast on snow.
One of my steps equals three of yours.
Do not run for the water.
The ice will break.
I come around from behind a drift.
The sea is at your back.
I walk along behind you.
Not fast, but never stopping.
You leave tracks in the snow.
I see them plainly.
You glanced back once.
I am right there.
Your breath turns to white mist.
That mist will fade.
You will get cold first.
I can wait for that.
I rear up and come down.
Your shoulder is crushed sideways.
My claws hook into your clothes.
This one is not heavy.
But my paw is bigger than your shield.
You were batted back two steps.
And I come with the same paw again.

lines.zh: 雪地上留下你滑的痕迹。
lines.en: Your skid marks show in the snow.
I strike again, higher this time.
You are driven down into the snow.
I walk out of the blowing snow.
Ice crusts my coat.
This place is a little warmer than the north.
Cold enough, still.
I raise my head and see the shore.
The snow is clean; no one has passed.
I walk slowly forward.

lines.zh: 脚印会告诉他们我来过。
lines.en: My tracks will announce me.
But not soon enough.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声在冰上传得远。
lines.en: My steps carry far over the ice.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的毛，一阵焦糊。
lines.en: Fire scorches my coat and reeks.

lines.zh: 我从浮冰上滑下去，撞在冰面。
lines.en: I slide off the floe and hit the ice.

lines.zh: 冰水漫过我，我朝亮处游。
lines.en: Icy water closes over me; I swim for the light.

lines.zh: 爆风把我推在雪里滑了很远。
lines.en: The blast shoves me sliding through the snow.
An arrow buries in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的爪子一阵发麻。
lines.en: That light numbs my claws.
Too long hungry; my legs will not carry me.
Lightning strikes my back and my coat stands.

lines.zh: 脚下的冰没有了，我掉下去。
lines.en: The ice is gone and I fall.
